decisions.title: Autonomous agent option C with tools and durable memory
decisions.context: Owner explicitly chose option C; practical tasks are primary, not avatar realism.
decisions.decision: Keep core task orchestration and memory first.
decisions.revisit_when: Product goals or user priority change.

decisions.title: Single-user modular monolith on Windows
decisions.context: Lower operational cost than microservices for one host and user.
decisions.decision: Python application with clean ports; workers logical.
decisions.revisit_when: Multiple independent users or remote deployment needs arise.

decisions.title: SQLite with FTS5 as initial durable store
decisions.context: Local low-administration default with versioned migrations.
decisions.decision: Use abstraction for semantic index and potential PostgreSQL replacement.
decisions.revisit_when: Concurrency, scale or retrieval benchmark fails.

decisions.title: LLM/provider-agnostic identity and model router
decisions.context: Preserve user continuity across local and cloud models.
decisions.decision: Never store identity or task truth in model weights alone.

decisions.title: Local by default; cloud explicit opt-in
decisions.context: Respects privacy and offline utility without giving up quality.
decisions.revisit_when: Owner supplies different data transfer constraints.

decisions.title: Tool registry and authorization before execution
decisions.context: Action correctness and side-effect safety cannot be delegated to LLM.
decisions.decision: Typed tools, policy gates, audit and verifier.
decisions.revisit_when: Security review finds stronger isolation needed.

decisions.title: Versioned facts/events and project-scoped retrieval
decisions.context: Source lineage and contradictory decisions must remain inspectable.
decisions.decision: Store provenance and supersession, not overwrite summaries.
decisions.revisit_when: Storage benchmark or privacy requirement changes.

decisions.title: Controlled skill evolution; no autonomous core changes
decisions.context: Useful improvement without uncontrolled code execution.

decisions.title: No automatic weight fine-tuning in initial releases
decisions.context: Insufficient curated examples and benchmark at project start.
decisions.revisit_when: Sufficient training data and success metric exist.

decisions.title: Browser via Playwright where suitable; MCP optional
decisions.context: Browser automation needs deterministic safety and observation.
decisions.decision: Treat MCP as adapter, not central dependency.

decisions.title: Telegram bot before personal-account integration
decisions.context: Separate channel simpler to secure, test and audit.

decisions.title: JSON canonical specs, Markdown explanatory documents
decisions.context: Stable IDs, easy AI indexing and stdlib validation.

decisions.title: No default multi-agent orchestration
decisions.context: One orchestrator and bounded tools simpler to debug and evaluate.

decisions.title: Conservative action approvals and no automatic external sends
decisions.context: Avoid unapproved communication, purchases and OS changes.
